coverage: All expert counts0..1024, MT32/64, empty/full lists and grids1/2/4/132/264.
progress: Only bounded tile computation and monotonic atomic claiming. No cross-CTA wait or resident-grid assumption. W13/W2 have independent heads, both reset by the route kernel every replay.
ordering: Route completes before fork; each stream waits on fork. W2 follows the full compact W13 kernel on the same stream. Every tile retires WGMMA and crosses a CTA barrier before ticket/scratch reuse. Parent copy_sync_check.py covers the unchanged S2/S3 rings.
limitation: Contract model and source coverage; hardware race freedom not exhaustively tested.
